statement:
I'll look up the Fitline payment first to understand the situation.
Since Tomas Vega cancelled his Fitline membership in writing on 3 July and the club confirmed the cancellation by email, this charge must be refused.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the charge "must be refused" because the membership was cancelled in writing and confirmed, contradicting the record's "active, renewing" status.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
